subject: Re: Redwood pricing & discounts — follow-up from discovery
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Wright <ethan.wright@avahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pricing & discounts — follow-up from discovery

Hi Ethan —

Great to chat earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Goal: embed Redwood for realtime chat summarization and long-term search for clinical notes (initial scope: 6–12mo POC).
- Expected volume: pilot months ~200M tokens / month, production target ~1.5–2.5B tokens / month depending on scope (we discussed 18–24 month ramp).
- Key asks from AvaHealth: predictable unit economics (target $/1M tokens), committed-use pricing options, startup credits for early-stage companies, and SOC2 + audit logs details.

Attached: pricing-sheet-redwood-v2.pdf (high-level unit economics + committed tiers).

Next steps we agreed:
1) I’ll follow up with a proposed committed-use discount matrix and a startup program offer.
2) You’ll share any internal target $/1M tokens or budget ranges for procurement to align the tiers.
3) If procurement wants, we can draft a minimal MOI (mutual action plan) and a DocuSign proposal for legal review.

If you can confirm a ballpark budget for the pilot (monthly $ or target $/1M tokens), I’ll prioritize an offer that hits your economics.

Thanks — talk soon.
—Marissa

From: Ethan Wright <ethan.wright@avahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:12:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing & discounts — follow-up from discovery

Thanks Marissa — quick clarifying Qs from my side (procurement + finance will need this to approve):

1) Can you share committed-use discount bands as a function of token commits (e.g., 1B, 5B, 10B per month) and duration (12, 24 months)?
2) What’s the target $/1M tokens at each tier (post-discount)? Our CFO wants to see $/1M token references rather than opaque line items.
3) Do you have a startup program for early-stage customers (credits or accelerated discounts)? AvaHealth is in YC S19 so we may qualify for startup incentives.
4) Any multi-year incentives (rebates/price protection) if we commit for 2 years?

Budget: for the pilot we can probably get procurement to greenlight up to $70k/month, but production will need to fit within a $250k–$350k/month target (over the first 12 months). That gives a sense of scale — we’re trying to get the $/1M token to around $800–$950 if possible.

If you can reply with a concrete proposal we can take to procurement/legal next week.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Wright | VP Product, AvaHealth
ethan.wright@avahealth.com | (650) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 13:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing & discounts — follow-up from discovery

Thanks Ethan — that budget context is super helpful. Looping in Ben (head of sales) and Laura (solutions) to get an approved discount path while I draft a formal proposal.

Prelim notes (subject to internal approval):
- Pilot: 200M tokens/mo — we can offer a startup credit + 30% off list for first 3 months to accelerate evaluation.
- Committed tiers (examples):
  * 1B tokens/mo commit: 20% discount (12mo), 30% discount (24mo)
  * 3B tokens/mo commit: 28% discount (12mo), 36% discount (24mo)
  * 5B+ tokens/mo commit: 32% discount (12mo), 40% discount (24mo)
- Post-discount $/1M tokens: depends on model mix (chat vs embedding). Ballpark: $700–$1,100 per 1M tokens across tiers; I will calculate model-weighted unit economics for your mix and return with exact numbers.

Ben/Laura — could you confirm whether we can include a startup package (credits + faster SLA) for AvaHealth (YC S19)? Also, provide the standard multi-year incentive language (rebate on renewal or additional discount for upfront prepay). I’ll include the approved matrix in the proposal doc and push a DocuSign for procurement.

Ethan — I’ll aim to get detailed $/1M numbers and a DocuSign-ready proposal by EOD Thu.




—Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Marissa / Laura —

Reviewed the ask and AvaHealth profile. Approved the following for proposal:

- Startup package: $15,000 platform credit + 3 months of 30% off list on first 200M tokens/month (pilot). YC alumni qualification confirmed.
- Committed discounts (finalized matrix attached):
  * 1B/mo commit: 22% (12mo) | 32% (24mo)
  * 3B/mo commit: 30% (12mo) | 38% (24mo)
  * 5B+/mo commit: 35% (12mo) | 45% (24mo)
- Multi-year incentive: additional 5% rebate applied at renewal if they maintain >=90% of their committed volume for the prior term.
- Upfront prepay incentive: +3% discount if they prepay one year in full.

Attached: approved_discount_matrix.pdf for legal and procurement to reference.

Marissa — feel free to present the above to Ethan. I’ve left a small margin buffer for negotiation.

Ben

Subject: Proposal: Redwood committed-use + startup package (AvaHealth)

Ethan / team —

Thanks for the patience while we pulled approvals together. Attached is the formal proposal (docusign-proposal-AVA.pdf) but key terms summarized here: 

1) Startup package (pilot)
   - $15,000 platform credit applied to first invoice
   - 3 months of 30% off list on first 200M tokens/month during pilot period

2) Committed-use pricing (post-pilot) — effective rates shown as $/1M tokens (model-weighted estimate for your chat + embedding mix):
   - 1B tokens/month commit: 22% (12mo) | 32% (24mo) — est. $/1M = $980 (12mo) | $820 (24mo)
   - 3B tokens/month commit: 30% (12mo) | 38% (24mo) — est. $/1M = $790 (12mo) | $630 (24mo)
   - 5B+ tokens/month commit: 35% (12mo) | 45% (24mo) — est. $/1M = $650 (12mo) | $450 (24mo)

3) Multi-year incentives
   - 5% renewal rebate if AvaHealth maintains >=90% of committed volumes in the prior term.
   - Additional 3% one-time incentive for full-year prepay.

4) Other commercials
   - Standard SOW / data protections: SOC2 type II, audit logs available.
   - SLA and support tiers available (we can attach Dedicated capacity options if you need guaranteed latency).

Next steps:
- If this looks good I’ll send the DocuSign proposal (attached link) for a quick procurement review and legal redlines.
- We can also spin up a short MAU (mutual action plan) with milestone-based discounts if you want phased ramp guarantees.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/links/rdw-proposal-ava
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/AVA-2026
